description: The window talks HTTP to its engine; the shell owns the windows, the engine sidecar, downloads, external links and updates. The page the engine serves on 127.0.0.1 is a remote origin to Tauri, so the capability lists that address: on macOS the page sets its menus in the system menu bar (core:default includes the core menu permissions), and the Window and File menus minimize, zoom and close the window.
